na_skrywer.voor: Noem 'n baken by elke stap, en die naam van die pad as die pad een het.
na_skrywer.na: Noem 'n baken by elke stap en die naam van die pad as dit een het.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The part after 'en' has no subject and verb of its own, so AWS 2017 takes no comma; 'dit' also avoids repeating 'die pad'.
na_skrywer.fout: The comma before 'en' is wrong under AWS 2017: 'die naam van die pad' is a second object of 'Noem', not a clause with its own subject and verb.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The comma removal is right, but the bundled swap of 'die pad' for 'dit' makes the pronoun able to point to 'baken' (landmarks have names too), so only the comma should go and 'as die pad een het' should stay.
